out_of_scope_observations.observation: Codex round-3 F2 (real bug). abortTurnWithFallback → client.reconnectAndResumeThread() → client.resumeThread() rotates client._threadId internally (codexAppServerClient.ts:856) but the wrapper does NOT call notifyDaemonOfCodexTid, so a rotated tid skips daemon metadata sync + process.title update. The BA spec M2' centralization claim covered start path (runCodex.ts:712) and explicit resume path (resumeExistingThread.ts:37) only; this forced-restart-resume path is a third call site the spec did not enumerate. Fix would extend runCodex.ts (already 822-line file with pre-existing quality-gate block). Recommend a follow-up cycle to: (a) add post-fallback notify after abortResult.resumedThread=true, (b) compare client.threadId against the pre-abort threadId snapshot to detect rotation, (c) re-call notifyDaemonOfCodexTid only when the tid changed.

Codex round-3 F1. runStartupSweep starts runSweepInline EXECUTING immediately and then enqueues a no-op awaiting that promise. Subsequent upsert/remove tasks block on the sweep, but the sweep itself is not 'inside' the serialization chain. The pattern is sound for the single startup-call usage; a future periodic-sweep cycle should re-enter through enqueue() proper to remain race-free. Codex round-2 #1 in BA-QA also flagged this as a pre-existing pattern. Comment added inline noting the limitation; refactor deferred.

Pre-existing 822-line file with 794-line startDaemon function. Quality-gate file-size cap is 800 lines; the file is 22 lines over before this cycle's edits. Any new wiring is forced to use line-folding tricks to avoid net growth. Recommend a separate refactor cycle to split startDaemon into setup phases. Not in scope this cycle.
